description: This source file defines a final class 'ScreenController' responsible for managing a web view's content, URL navigation, debug status, and interactions within an iOS application. It includes methods for URL handling, snapshot generation, and communication with embedded web content.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A controller managing a WKWebView, handling URL navigation, debug status, and messaging between native and web components.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a given URL string, trusting A2UI actions if specified, with special handling for loopback URLs.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current web view based on the current URL string or default scaffold if empty.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets the URL to show the default canvas.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay in the web view.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug overlay's title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Sets the JSON string representing the home canvas state and applies it.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Injects JavaScript to render the home canvas state into the web view.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the web UI inside the web view to become ready, with a timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code inside the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the web view and returns it as a Base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in specified format (PNG or JPEG) as a Base64 string, with optional quality parameter for JPEG.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Associates a WKWebView with the controller and performs initial setup.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Disassociates the given WKWebView if it is currently attached.
